outline: The exponential increase of data in different organizations and industries poses some challenges in regard to data storage, data analysis, and data transformation. Data mining can assist data analysts and decision makers across the organization to make intelligent use of these vast amounts of data to enhance performance in their organization and ensure the competitiveness. This course aims to introduce the foundations of data mining for industries and organizations from the fundamental theoretical concepts to applications. This course will also help the students to understand the data warehouse and methods for data pre-processing using Matlab or any data mining tools such as Weka. Supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms for data mining will be covered in this class. Evaluation metrics for data mining algorithms will also be studied.
schedule:
-Introduction to Data Mining.
-Data Mining Applications.
-Data Preprocessing.
-Data Warehousing.
-Mining Frequent Patterns, Associations, and Correlations.
-Classification.
-Cluster Analysis.
-Outlier Detection.
